claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cyclophosphamide requires hepatic CYP-mediated activation to 4-hydroxycyclophosphamide/phosphoramide mustard, which crosslinks DNA; at 2.5 uM over 5 days in a pooled cell-line screen without liver metabolism, little or no active alkylator is generated, so killing is expected to be minimal.
